Subject: Cascade 45L is back in stock
Preview: The pack you had your eye on is available again.
Body: The Northbay Cascade 45L Trekking Pack is restocked.

If you're planning a multi-day trip and need a pack that fits the load without adding unnecessary weight, this is worth a look.

The Cascade 45L carries up to 45 liters of gear — enough for a 3–4 day carry when you pack with intention. At 1.4 kg, the internal frame keeps weight off your back without sacrificing structure on uneven terrain.

The shell is ripstop nylon with water resistance built in. It handles light rain and trail splash. It is not waterproof — if you're heading into sustained rain, a pack cover is the honest move.

That's the pack. No discount, no countdown. Just back in stock and ready if you need it.
